items.micro_skill: split a total in a ratio
items.stem: Cora and Nestor will share ₱12,500 of cleanup fund in the ratio 2 : 3. How much is Nestor's share?

reveal.terms: A ratio of 2 : 3 means for every 2 pesos one person gets, the other gets 3 pesos.
reveal.shortcut: Add the ratio numbers to get equal parts: 2 + 3 = 5. One part = ₱12,500 ÷ 5 = ₱2,500. Then multiply by the parts you need.

why_wrong.o2: ₱4,166.67 divides the total by 3 alone, not by all 5 parts.
why_wrong.o4: ₱5,000 is Cora's share (2 parts). The question asks for Nestor.

items.stem: In alphabetical filing, which name is filed LAST?  Engr. Liza B. Del Rosario | Nora A. Reyes-Tan | Carlos A. Dela Cruz | Atty. Cristina P. Cruz-Manalo

reveal.terms: "Indexing" means writing a name in filing order: surname first, then given name, then middle initial. A title such as Dr. is the last unit.
reveal.shortcut: Rewrite each surname as one block: drop spaces and hyphens, keep the prefix (Dela Cruz = DELACRUZ). Then compare letter by letter (ARMA Rule 1). Order: Atty. Cristina P. Cruz-Manalo → CRUZMANALO, Cristina; Carlos A. Dela Cruz → DELACRUZ, Carlos; Engr. Liza B. Del Rosario → DELROSARIO, Liza; Nora A. Reyes-Tan → REYESTAN, Nora.
reveal.why_correct: "Nora A. Reyes-Tan" is right. It comes last when every name is indexed surname first, letter by letter. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 6), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o2: "Atty. Cristina P. Cruz-Manalo" sorts by the title (Dr., Atty., Engr.). A title is only the last unit.
why_wrong.o3: "Carlos A. Dela Cruz" files as DELACRUZ, which comes before REYESTAN.

items.stem: In alphabetical filing, which name is filed LAST?  Dr. Danilo T. Delos Reyes | Nora G. De los Santos | Atty. Liza L. De Leon | Eduardo E. San Juan

reveal.terms: "Indexing" means writing a name in filing order: surname first, then given name, then middle initial. A title such as Dr. is the last unit.
reveal.shortcut: Rewrite each surname as one block: drop spaces and hyphens, keep the prefix (Dela Cruz = DELACRUZ). Then compare letter by letter (ARMA Rule 1). Order: Atty. Liza L. De Leon → DELEON, Liza; Dr. Danilo T. Delos Reyes → DELOSREYES, Danilo; Nora G. De los Santos → DELOSSANTOS, Nora; Eduardo E. San Juan → SANJUAN, Eduardo.
reveal.why_correct: "Eduardo E. San Juan" is right. It comes last when every name is indexed surname first, letter by letter. This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 6), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o1: "Dr. Danilo T. Delos Reyes" files as DELOSREYES, which comes before SANJUAN.
why_wrong.o3: "Atty. Liza L. De Leon" sorts by the title (Dr., Atty., Engr.). A title is only the last unit.
why_wrong.o4: "Nora G. De los Santos" files the prefix as a separate word (for example "Dela Cruz" under C). A prefix joins the rest of the surname.
